import json,time,tracemalloc
from storymodel import make_account
from storymodel.model import Document,Unit,Support,Span
from storymodel.reconstruction import ReconstructionRow,ReconstructionMass,ReconstructionSpec,ReconstructionPolicy,reconstruct_rows
from storymodel.sequence import SequenceState

def account(side,n):
 d=Document.create('reconstruction-scale-'+side,side,'A'*n)
 units=tuple(Unit(kind='row' if side=='source' else 'recall',support=Support(document=d.id,spans=(Span(start=i,end=i+1),))) for i in range(n))
 return make_account((d,),units=units),units
out=[]
for n in (50,500):
 source,anchors=account('source',n);recall,units=account('recall',200)
 rows=tuple(ReconstructionRow(unit=u.id,mass=tuple(ReconstructionMass(state=SequenceState(kind='source',anchor_kind='segment',anchor=anchors[(i*4+j)%n].id),weight=w) for j,w in enumerate((.4,.3,.2,.1)))) for i,u in enumerate(units))
 spec=ReconstructionSpec(roots={u.id:i for i,u in enumerate(anchors)},policy=ReconstructionPolicy(order='nondecreasing'))
 tracemalloc.start(); start=time.perf_counter()
 result=reconstruct_rows(source,recall,rows,spec)
 seconds=time.perf_counter()-start;_,peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory();tracemalloc.stop()
 assert len(result.decisions)==200
 groups=[d.assigned_group for d in result.decisions]
 assert groups==sorted(groups)
 out.append(dict(source_nodes=n,recall_rows=200,state_weights=800,active_groups=n,seconds=seconds,peak_python_bytes=peak))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
